primary_text.en:
An assistant that writes like the founder is no use when the client emailed a junior bookkeeper.

DoviLoop builds a voice profile for every mailbox from that person's own sent mail, then drafts the reply there - grounded in your documents, not the internet.

Nothing sends until they read it. It never leaves Outlook.

description.en: Drafted in the Outlook your team already uses
